title: Luxury Glass Sphere — Hero App Icon
prompt: Luxury glassmorphic logo for a voice-first African fintech, on a soft pearl-white background (#DDE8ED) with a gentle radial glow. A transparent glowing glass sphere with a bright neon-mint core (#69CEA9) at its center marking a confirmed payment. Two smooth, refined orbit rings in electric cyan (#70D0E0) wrap the sphere like secure routes. Behind the sphere, a single soft horizontal audio waveform runs through, electric cyan on the left fading into warm gold (#F4DFA0) on the right. Delicate glass reflections and soft aqua (#A9D3DF) highlights on the sphere. Beneath, the wordmark 'ONGEA PESA' in a bold premium rounded sans-serif with a subtle metallic deep-navy-to-cyan gradient (#2A5D73 to #70D0E0), wide tracking, exact spelling. Clean, expensive, minimal, app-store ready.
negative_prompt: currency sparks, dollar signs, coins, microphone, arrows, noisy particles, clutter, dark background, distorted orb, misspelling, cheap 3D, low-res

brand_lock.one_idea: glass sphere + mint core + 2 rings + 1 waveform (cyan to gold) behind

notes: Decluttered 'Glassmorphic Payment Sphere'. The most luxurious option — marketing hero / app store. The cyan-to-gold waveform is the signature touch here.
